title: Lease Provision Extraction Output
description: Stage 1 output: extracted and aligned provisions from template and tenant lease, plus contract metadata and deal overview

deal_overview.description: Structured deal summary extracted from lease preamble, recitals, and key provisions

lease_term_years.description: Lease term duration in years. A number ONLY when lease_term_basis is 'fixed_years'. MUST be null for every other basis — a contingent, event-triggered, month-to-month or undetermined term has no correct numeric value, and inventing one is worse than recording its absence.

lease_term_basis.description: How the lease term is defined. fixed_years: a definite term expressible in years. contingent: term ends on the occurrence of one or more conditions, not on a date. event_triggered: term runs from or to a defined event rather than a calendar date. month_to_month: periodic tenancy with no fixed end. undetermined: could not be determined from the document. THE DISTINCTION: contingent, event_triggered and month_to_month are PROPERTIES OF THE LEASE — the document says what it says and there is no number to find. undetermined is a FAILURE TO DETERMINE — the reader could not tell. Same distinction as NOT_APPLICABLE vs AMBIGUOUS on provision status.

cam_structure.description: CAM/operating expense structure (e.g. triple-net, gross, modified gross)

key_terms_summary.description: 3-6 bullet points of the most important business terms (TI allowance, assignment rights, cure periods, maintenance, etc.)

allOf.$comment: lease_term_years MUST be null whenever lease_term_basis is anything other than fixed_years. Enforced, not merely described.

template_text.description: Full extracted clause text from the standard template

tenant_text.description: Full extracted clause text from the tenant lease

status.description: Alignment status. NOT_APPLICABLE: provision known-absent for this document type (document-type-driven, not extraction failure). AMBIGUOUS: extraction failed or provision not found and not in known-absent set.

alignment_notes.description: Notes on differences or confirmation of equivalence

definition_changes.description: Relevant definition changes affecting this provision

discovered_provisions.description: Non-standard articles found in the tenant lease not covered by LP-01 through LP-18
